summary: AETHER-QKD is an interplanetary command and cryptography hub built by Team Aracus for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, combining futuristic Deep-Space Quantum Key Distribution (BB84) with historical Enigma code-breaking simulation suites. To address deep-space communication security, the platform simulates polarized photon transmission between deep-space probes and ground stations while integrating real-time atmospheric telemetry from the Meteomatics Weather API to dynamically model quantum channel noise and QBER safety thresholds. Furthermore, it features a dual-layer Enigma intercept and code-breaking lab to demonstrate robust encryption and signal decryption. This project is vital for advancing unhackable quantum communication architectures for future space missions.
details:
Aether-Net Interplanetary Command & Cryptography Hub (AETHER-QKD) is an advanced dual-layer security platform engineered for future interplanetary missions. It bridges futuristic Quantum Key Distribution (BB84) with historical Enigma-based code-breaking cipher suites, dynamically audited against real-time ground-station environmental data.

WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS:

- BB84 Quantum Protocol & Basis Sifting: Simulates Alice (deep-space probe) transmitting polarized photon streams across interplanetary distances to Bob (ground station), performing real-time basis sifting to generate secure cryptographic keys.

- Real-Time QBER Security Auditing: Integrates live meteorological data from the Meteomatics Weather API (/now/ endpoint) to dynamically evaluate the Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) against real-world environmental noise factors (ground temperature, humidity, and wind speed) to ensure channel security remains below the critical 11% threshold.

- Enigma Intercept & Code-Breaking Lab: Provides a dual-mode rotor-based cipher interface for encrypting deep-space telemetry and decrypting intercepted operational intelligence.

- Interplanetary Telemetry Dashboard: A high-visibility, cinematic deep-space command interface featuring live atmospheric metrics, high-contrast typography, and atmospheric link status monitors.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT:

As humanity reaches deeper into the cosmos, secure communication across interplanetary distances becomes paramount. Traditional encryption remains vulnerable to quantum computing advancements. AETHER-QKD ensures that deep-space probes and ground stations can establish unbreakable, error-audited quantum links while maintaining absolute operational readiness under varying atmospheric conditions.

TECHNOLOGY STACK:

- Frontend & UI: Python Streamlit (Community Cloud Deployed), Custom CSS High-Contrast Deep-Space UI Styling.

- Backend Logic: Python, Random, Pandas.

- API Integration: Meteomatics Weather API (/now/t_2m:C,relative_humidity_2m:p,wind_speed_10m:ms/) for real-time atmospheric auditing.

- Version Control & Deployment: Git, GitHub, Streamlit Cloud.
